|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E4 of [[Krayt Dragon Howl & Armed And Dangerous (V)]]; it is the current text. Other versions: [[Krayt Dragon Howl & Armed And Dangerous (V)]] (Original), [[Armed And Dangerous & Krayt Dragon Howl (V)]] (PC-E1), [[Armed And Dangerous & Krayt Dragon Howl (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2), [[Armed And Dangerous & Krayt Dragon Howl (V) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3). The image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1261-93-front-master.png]]; the new title; art split between the sheet slip's picture and the card image's; no slip number).
* '''Original''' ([[Krayt Dragon Howl & Armed And Dangerous (V)]]): printed as “•Krayt Dragon Howl & •Armed And Dangerous” on the first copy of the Virtual Block 6.1 (Reflections IV) release sheet (official text as of 4 September 2009)<ref name="sheet-6_1-first">Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV sheet, first copy ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; attachment Block6WithRebelFleetV.pdf, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1375528 Players Committee forum])</ref> and its revised copy (20 April 2010)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_1-revised">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf#page=12 Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet], revised copy (PDF dated 20 April 2010), page 12, slip 91. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195540/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf#page=12 Internet Archive]</ref>: “USED: Cancel Disarmed or Stunning Leader. OR If a battle was just initiated, ▼ (or deploy from hand) a character weapon on your participating character. LOST: Use 1 Force to ▼ (or retrieve) non-[Reflections 3] Obi-Wan. OR If opponent just initiated a battle against non-[Reflections 3] Obi-Wan alone at a site, his forfeit cannot be reduced.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Armed And Dangerous & Krayt Dragon Howl (V)]]): renamed on the Players Committee forum on 14 July 2011 “to have it be consistent with the rest of the PC created combo cards”<ref name="forum-p636351">Players Committee forum, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=48201, now titled “Current Rulings Archive July 2010 - August 2012”), post by Aglets, 14 July 2011: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=48201&start=20#p636351 p636351] (read 9–11 November 2026)</ref>: “USED: Cancel Disarmed or Stunning Leader. OR If a battle was just initiated, ▼ (or deploy from hand) a character weapon on your participating character. LOST: Use 1 Force to ▼ (or retrieve) non-[Reflections 3] Obi-Wan. OR If opponent just initiated a battle against non-[Reflections 3] Obi-Wan alone at a site, his forfeit cannot be reduced.” The PC card directory already listed the card under the new title from 2 October 2009. '''What changed:''' the title “•Krayt Dragon Howl & •Armed And Dangerous” became “•Armed And Dangerous & •Krayt Dragon Howl”; the game text did not change.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Armed And Dangerous & Krayt Dragon Howl (V) (Errata 2)]]): the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013)<ref name="cl-1261_93-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142254/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 11 January 2013] (Internet Archive)</ref>: “USED: Cancel Disarmed or Stunning Leader. OR If a battle was just initiated, deploy a character weapon on your participating character from Reserve Deck (or hand); reshuffle. LOST: Use 1 Force to deploy (or retrieve) non-[Reflections III] Obi-Wan from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR If opponent just initiated a battle against non-[Reflections III] Obi-Wan alone at a site, his forfeit cannot be reduced.” '''What changed:''' nothing: the new title and the original text; the list writes the icons out (“deploy … from Reserve Deck (or hand); reshuffle”), which is notation (Bill, 11 November 2026). A repeat of an earlier text is a version of its own (wiki versions rulings, 11 November 2026).
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Armed And Dangerous & Krayt Dragon Howl (V) (Errata 3)]]): the Players Committee card image, dated 25 February 2013 on the PC image server<ref name="srv-Virtual6-Light">Players Committee card image server, directory listing of <code>cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual6-Light/large/</code>, every card image dated 25 February 2013: [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034714/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual6-Light/large/?C=M;O=A Internet Archive capture of 18 August 2019]. The files are byte for byte the ones still served today (research R6, 10–11 November 2026).</ref>: “USED: Cancel Disarmed or Stunning Leader. OR If a battle was just initiated, ▼ (or deploy from hand) a character weapon on your participating character. LOST: Use 1 Force to ▼ (or retrieve) non-[Reflections 3] Obi-Wan. OR If opponent just initiated a battle against non-[Reflections 3] Obi-Wan alone at a site, his forfeit cannot be reduced.” The server date is the date of a bulk upload of the whole folder: the image may have been made earlier, but it is placed at the date it can be shown to exist (Bill, 11 November 2026). '''What changed:''' nothing: the new title and the original text. A repeat of an earlier text is a version of its own (wiki versions rulings, 11 November 2026).
